questions.question: Who pledged himself as surety to persuade Jacob to send Benjamin?
How did Joseph react when he saw his brother Benjamin?
options: He grew angry and quickly turned away
He had him seized and thrown into prison
He was overcome and wept in private
He ignored him completely and said nothing
questions.answer: He was overcome and wept in private

questions.question: Joseph seated his brothers in the order of their ages, which amazed them.
At the meal, Benjamin was served _____ times as much as the others.
Jacob told his sons to take a gift and double the _____ to return what was in their sacks.
